name: Chainflip
description: Chainflip is a cross-chain AMM enabling native asset swaps without wrapped tokens or specialised wallets.

methodology.UserFees: Ingress, Egress, and Broker fees paid by the user per swap
methodology.Revenue: Fees collected from burning $FLIP. This is a fixed percentage of swap value.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Money going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees collected by the LP. This is a fixed percentage of swap value.
